typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Return_Date as string,
		ARB_No as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Trader as string,
		Finance_Rate as double,
		Finance_Date as timestamp,
		Tran_No as double,
		Customer_Acccount as string,
		Security as string,
		Sper_Code as string,
		Cusip as string,
		Init_date as timestamp,
		Exchange_Rate as double,
		Fin_Type as string,
		Currency as string,
		Last_Adj_Date as timestamp,
		Process_Date as timestamp,
		Client as double,
		To_Date_Fin_Int as double,
		Principal as double,
		Transaction_Amount as double,
		Daily_Fin_Int as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Return_Date as string,
		ARB_No as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Trader as string,
		Finance_Rate as double,
		Finance_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Tran_No as double,
		Customer_Acccount as string,
		Security as string,
		Sper_Code as string,
		Cusip as string,
		Init_date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Exchange_Rate as double,
		Fin_Type as string,
		Currency as string,
		Last_Adj_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Process_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Client as double,
		To_Date_Fin_Int as double,
		Principal as double,
		Transaction_Amount as double,
		Daily_Fin_Int as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Return_Date,
		ARB_No,
		Customer_Name,
		Trader,
		Finance_Rate,
		Finance_Date,
		Tran_No,
		Customer_Acccount,
		Security,
		Sper_Code,
		Cusip,
		Init_date,
		Exchange_Rate,
		Fin_Type,
		Currency,
		Last_Adj_Date,
		Process_Date,
		Client,
		To_Date_Fin_Int,
		Principal,
		Transaction_Amount,
		Daily_Fin_Int),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
